aiAssistant.title: AI Assistant
aiAssistant.description: Reads the note a rep writes or dictates on a prospect and fills in the campaign's segmentation categories, sales fields, lead rating and — when nothing else fits — a tag, then adds an AI note with what it couldn't place, questions worth asking and suggested next steps. A value a rep entered by hand is never overwritten. Turn it on per campaign, in that campaign's Settings.

offlineMode.title: Local mode (offline box)
offlineMode.intro: When the internet is down at an event, your sales team can keep working from their phones through the box: they join the Wi-Fi below, open the address, and enter the shared code. Everything they enter is sent to the cloud when the internet returns.

offlineMode.weakHint: Easy to guess: prefer 8+ characters with letters and numbers. Anyone on the box Wi-Fi who guesses it can see your prospects.
offlineMode.saved: Code saved. The box receives it at its next sync.
offlineMode.wipeNote: The box erases its copy of the contacts when the campaign has been over for 12 hours, or if it stays out of contact with the cloud for 10 days.
